functions.name: IsNaniteEnabled
functions.docs:
Returns true if this SM should have Nanite built for it.
This also includes the result of IsNaniteForceEnabled().

functions.name: IsNaniteForceEnabled
functions.docs:
Returns true if this SM should always have Nanite data built.
This forces the SM to be Nanite even if the flag in the editor is set to false.

functions.name: IsNaniteAssembly
functions.docs:
Returns true if this SM is comprised of instanced copies of other SMs for at least
part of its own internal structure.

functions.name: CacheNaniteAssemblyReferences
functions.docs:
Caches the static meshes referenced by the Nanite Assembly data for the mesh to be used for build. Must
be called on the game thread before any asynchronous building. You should only need to call this externally
if caching render data manually (as opposed to using CacheDerivedData on the game thread or async mesh build).

functions.name: ClearNaniteAssemblyReferenceCache
functions.docs:
Clears the cache of static meshes referenced by the Nanite Assembly data for this mesh. Must be called from the
game thread.

functions.name: HasCachedNaniteAssemblyReferences
functions.docs: Returns whether or not Nanite Assembly reference meshes are adequately cached for build (always true for non-assemblies).

functions.name: GetCachedNaniteAssemblyReferences
functions.docs:
Retrieves the cached array of static meshes referenced by the Nanite Assembly data.
NOTE: This array is only meant to contain anything during static mesh build.
